title: Skydome
description: A textured mountain panorama wrapped around a sky sphere, with a smaller globe at its center.
interaction: Drag to look around the panorama.

title: Cube Map
description: Six cubemap faces surround a reflective scene with orbit and zoom controls.
interaction: Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom. Switch between dolly and field-of-view zoom.

title: Normal Maps
description: A granite material with tangent-space normal mapping and moving illumination.
interaction: Drag to orbit around the granite object.

title: Point Lighting
description: A textured Earth with clouds, point lighting and specular highlights.
interaction: Move your pointer to shift the light across the globe.

title: PBR
description: A physically based car scene, including its material textures, environment and ground shadow.
interaction: Drag to orbit and scroll to zoom around the car.

title: Shadow Maps
description: An airplane casts a moving shadow over a textured water surface.
interaction: Drag to orbit and inspect the projected shadow.

title: GPGPU Particles
description: GPU particle simulation with position and velocity stored in ping-pong render targets.
interaction: Move your pointer to attract and disturb the particles.

title: Skinning
description: A skinned Snout character with skeletal animation and a soft ground shadow.
interaction: Drag to orbit around the animated character.

title: Load JSON
description: A textured fox mesh loaded from the JSON geometry format.

title: Particles
description: Animated particle geometry with point sprites and shader-driven colors.

title: Polylines
description: Colorful flowing polylines that follow your pointer.
interaction: Move your pointer across the preview.

title: Tube
description: A tube geometry generated along curved paths.
interaction: Drag to orbit and scroll to zoom.

title: Load GLTF
description: The Hershel model with glTF materials and environment lighting.
interaction: Drag to orbit and scroll to zoom around the model.

title: GLTF KTX2 Basis
description: A painterly cottage loaded with KTX2 Basis compressed textures and its local transcoder.
interaction: Drag to orbit and scroll to zoom around the cottage.

title: Sort Transparency
description: Layered transparent leaves with depth sorting as they rotate.
interaction: Inspect the intersecting transparent surfaces as they rotate.

title: Frustum Culling
description: An animated camera culls forest geometry outside its view.
interaction: Drag to orbit and inspect the trees inside the moving camera’s frustum.

title: Orbit Controls
description: A textured macaw with mouse and touch orbit controls and two zoom modes.
interaction: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, and use the zoom-style selector.

title: Mouse Flowmap
description: A water texture distorted by a mouse-driven flowmap simulation.
interaction: Move your pointer or touch and drag across the water.
